translations.web: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
translations.bsb: When the captain of the temple guard and the chief priests heard this account, they were perplexed as to what was happening.
translations.kjv: Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, they doubted of them whereunto this would grow.
translations.asv: Now when the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these words, they were much perplexed concerning them whereunto this would grow.
